spec.description: D-Scan Space site and updater: traffic, ESI, background jobs, database and Node.js runtime.
Whether Prometheus can scrape the site and the updater (`up`).
spec.title: Up

spec.description: Requests handled by the site (healthchecks excluded).
spec.title: Requests / s

spec.expr:
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$Job", instance_id="$Main_Instance", route!="/healthz", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
/
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$Job", instance_id="$Main_Instance", route!="/healthz"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Share of requests answered with 5xx.
spec.title: 5xx rate

spec.description: 95th percentile of request duration (healthchecks excluded).
spec.title: p95 latency

spec.description: New scans and scan updates stored in the selected time range.
spec.title: Scans

spec.description: Successful runs of the dynamic update job in the last 15 minutes (it is scheduled every minute). A run counts as failed when it errors or when Tranquility is unavailable and the run is skipped. 0 means the updater is not refreshing data; its container healthcheck uses the same 15 minute window.
spec.title: Updater runs (15m)

spec.description: Lowest remaining ESI error limit (`X-ESI-Error-Limit-Remain`, 100 per window) seen by either process in the time range. ESI blocks the app at 0; the client pauses requests itself at 10.
spec.title: ESI budget

spec.description: Request rate by status class (healthchecks excluded).
spec.title: Requests by status

spec.description: Request duration percentiles (healthchecks excluded).
spec.title: Response time

spec.expr:
round(sum by(route) (increase(http_requests_total{job="$Job", instance_id="$Main_Instance", route!="/healthz", status=~"5.."}[$__range])))
or
0 * sum by(route) (increase(http_requests_total{job="$Job", instance_id="$Main_Instance", route!="/healthz"}[$__range]))

sum by(route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="$Job", instance_id="$Main_Instance", route!="/healthz"}[$__range]))
/
sum by(route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$Job", instance_id="$Main_Instance", route!="/healthz"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(route, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$Job", instance_id="$Main_Instance", route!="/healthz"}[$__range])))

spec.description: Per route over the selected time range: requests, server errors, average and p95 duration. `unknown` collects URLs that match no route (404s).
spec.title: Routes

spec.description: Requests per duration bucket (healthchecks excluded).
spec.title: Response time distribution

spec.description: Scans stored per interval, by scan type.
spec.title: Scans created

spec.description: Average time to process a pasted scan (parse, ESI lookups for local, type lookups for d-scans), per interval.
spec.title: Scan processing time (avg)

spec.description: Average pilots per local scan / objects per d-scan, per interval.
spec.title: Scan size (avg)

spec.description: Share of pilots in local scans served from the database without an ESI refresh, per interval.
spec.title: Local scan cache hit ratio

spec.description: ESI request rate per process and response status ("network error": no response).
spec.title: ESI requests by status

spec.description: ESI request rate by resource type (both processes).
spec.title: ESI requests by resource

spec.description: ESI request duration percentiles per process (includes time waiting for a free connection slot).
spec.title: ESI latency

spec.description: ESI requests per duration bucket (both processes).
spec.title: ESI latency distribution

spec.description: Highest number of concurrent ESI requests per process (limit: `ESI_MAX_CONCURRENCY`).
spec.title: ESI requests in flight

spec.description: Remaining ESI error budget per process (left axis, 100 per window) and seconds until the window resets (right axis). Below 10 the client pauses all ESI requests until the reset.
spec.title: ESI error limit

spec.description: ESI responses by status over the selected time range (both processes).
spec.title: ESI responses (time range)

spec.description: Runs per interval by job and result. `updateDynamicData` runs on DYNAMIC_UPDATE_CRON (failed also when TQ is down and the run is skipped), `updateStaticData` on STATIC_UPDATE_CRON (SDE).
spec.title: Job runs

spec.description: Average run time per job and interval.
spec.title: Job duration (avg per run)

spec.description: Characters, corporations and alliances refreshed from ESI per interval.
spec.title: Entities refreshed

spec.description: Runs of the dynamic update job per duration bucket.
spec.title: Dynamic update duration distribution

spec.description: Connections in use and requests waiting for one, per process; dashed: pool maximum.
spec.title: Connection pool

spec.description: Database queries per second by statement type (both processes).
spec.title: Queries / s

spec.description: Average and p95 query duration per process. pg reports coarse buckets (1/5/10/50/100 ms, ...), so p95 is an upper-bound estimate.
spec.title: Query duration

spec.description: Database queries per duration bucket (both processes).
spec.title: Query duration distribution

spec.description: How late timers fire; high values mean the process is CPU-bound or blocked.
spec.title: Event loop delay (p99)

spec.description: Share of time the event loop is busy.
spec.title: Event loop utilization

spec.description: V8 heap in use per process.
spec.title: Heap used

spec.title: Time in GC
